name: Southern Cross Telco
summary: Hobart-founded retail telco (Southern Cross Telco Holdings Ltd, 1994; phone/mobile/broadband, ~A$44.4m revenue); Orion subsidiary (via NewTel from 2004); came to M2 automatically with Orion in Oct 2007. Not the Southern Cross Cable (ACN 066 034 400).

events.details: Southern Cross Telco Holdings Ltd founded Hobart 1994 (phone/mobile/broadband retail + SME).
Came to M2 Group automatically via the Orion scheme (Orion's largest subsidiary since 2004) — not a separate acquisition; Vocus-style lists double-count it.
